fusions.name: Kicked Scree
fusions.desc: Your hind legs kick 3 jagged stones in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 7 damage and knocking what it hits back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Up From Under
fusions.desc: You burrow to a target up to 5 tiles away and erupt beneath it for 30 damage, ignoring its armour, and leave it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Toadstone
fusions.desc: You burrow and surface 2 tiles from where you stood, and your armour rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
